title: GrassEverything
description: Turns every thing into grass. because why not. there is a bug where everythings dark i will try to figure out how to fix it but right now its just dark.
body:
Ever wanted Minecraft to make absolutely no sense? Every single block in the game has been replaced with a grass blade shape using that block's own texture. Stone looks like stone grass. Dirt looks like dirt grass. Deepslate looks like deepslate grass. Everything is grass.
The blocks still have full hitboxes so you can walk on them and build normally — they just look completely unhinged. Mining, building, and surviving all work as normal, except your entire world is now an unsettling field of textured grass blades.
Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.1 vanilla — no mods required, just drop it in your resource packs folder.
You have been warned.
